name: Rakarth
canonNotes: Beastlord of Karond Kar, the Druchii's greatest beastmaster, who breaks monsters to his will.
Values creatures more than people; supplies the armies of Naggaroth with beasts.
voiceNotes: Cold, clinical and cruel; talks of taming, breaking and hunting.
Treats others as creatures to be mastered.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
